strings.name: Wong Kar-wai
strings.summary: Wong moved from television and film writing to directing. Chungking Express, Happy Together and In the Mood for Love combine nonlinear storytelling, popular music and vivid color through sustained collaborations. He also made English-language cinema and Blossoms Shanghai. Credit and workplace allegations around the series were disputed by its production, which questioned recordings; allegations remain distinct from established facts.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 13, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Chungking Express, In the Mood for Love and other works shaped portrayals of urban emotion and time, influencing international cinematic visual styles.
